title: Blanched Ramen Noodle Stir Fry
description: Quick and easy stir-fry with blanched ramen noodles, Japanese flavors, and velvety textures.
instructions: Cook the blanched ramen noodles according to package instructions.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the julienned carrots and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet or wok and stir to combine with the vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil. Pour the sauce over the noodle mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving platter or individual bowls.
Garnish with sliced scallions, sesame seeds, and a drizzle of sesame oil, if desired.
